title: Helsinki Grotesk Pro / Regular and Regular Italic
slide_intent: Judge regular and regular italic in real words and paragraphs so weight and slant can be chosen for both voice and reading.
strategic_value: The regular and regular italic specimens can help Helsinki retain a consistent family while selecting an appropriate degree of emphasis.
demonstration: A two-column specimen combines Latin upright and italic words, an English paragraph and oversized Re It 75124.
practical_value: Compare the regular and regular italic cuts at display and paragraph scale before assigning them to a communication.

content_islands.name: Word specimens
content_islands.spec: Large words demonstrate the selected upright and italic cuts.

content_islands.name: Paragraph and large forms
content_islands.spec: A smaller paragraph and oversized letter or numeral forms provide contrasting reading scales.
